# Typography Vortex

Adapted from ThreeUI Community, https://threeui.com/text-animation/typography-vortex.
MIT; see LICENSE. Cached source: threeui-live/src/shaders/typography-vortex.
Local changes: seeded dust/rings, palette and font configuration, DPR 1.25,
full-size decorative canvas, bounded ring textures, local animation clock.
Visibility/reduced-motion and pointer forwarding are supplied by LibrarySurface.
